Checkout.title: Complete Your Adoption
Checkout.subtitle: Secure full payment by credit or debit card (Visa, Mastercard).
Checkout.holdNotice: Your selected animal is reserved exclusively for you for {minutes} minutes.
Checkout.holdExpired: Your {minutes}-minute reservation has expired. Please start the checkout again.
Checkout.termsCheckbox: I acknowledge and accept without reservation the Terms of Sale and the Privacy Policy. I understand this initiates an official veterinary preparation protocol.
Checkout.termsError: You must accept the terms of service to proceed.
Checkout.secureBadge: Secure card payment with 3D Secure authentication.

Checkout.xofConsentError: Please authorize the amount that will be charged.
